login.description: Enter your email and password to access your dashboard.

register.metaDescription: Create your {brand} account to manage your services.
register.description: Sign up to manage your VPS, dedicated servers and billing from a single dashboard.

account.description: Your customer details. You can edit them whenever you like.
account.securityIntro: Change your password. You'll need to enter your current one and repeat the new one.
account.invoicesIntro: Your invoices and proformas, with their status and PDF download.
account.invoicesPending: You have {count, plural, one {# invoice awaiting payment} other {# invoices awaiting payment}}.
account.supportIntro: Open a ticket and follow the conversation with our team.
account.supportOpen: You have {count, plural, one {# open ticket} other {# open tickets}}.
account.deploymentsIntro: Your VPS is being created. It usually takes under a minute.
account.emailIntro: Your current email is {email}. To change it we'll send a confirmation link to the new address.

cart.metaDescription: Review your cart and complete your order at {brand}.
cart.description: Review the plans you've selected, adjust quantities and complete your order.

loginForm.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.
loginForm.mfaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you don't have your phone, use one of your recovery codes.
loginForm.mfaErrorExpired: Too much time has passed. Please enter your password again.

registerForm.errorPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
registerForm.errorTerms: You must accept the terms to continue.
registerForm.errorGeneric: Could not create the account. Check the fields.
registerForm.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.

changePasswordForm.errorPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
changePasswordForm.errorGeneric: Could not change the password. Check the fields.
changePasswordForm.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.

cartView.orderRegisteredText: We have registered your order. We will email you the proforma with the amount and the payment reference; your service is activated as soon as the transfer arrives.
cartView.emptyText: Add a VPS or dedicated server to get started.
cartView.accountNeeded: To complete your order you need an account. It only takes a minute and your cart will be waiting for you.
cartView.errorSessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again to complete the order.
cartView.errorGeneric: Could not complete the order. Try again.
cartView.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.
cartView.cardUnavailable: Card payment is not available right now. You can pay by bank transfer using the details below.
cartView.orderRegisteredWithProforma: We have registered your order and issued proforma {numero}, which is also on its way to your inbox. Your service is activated as soon as the payment arrives.
cartView.domainHint: No domain yet? Leave it blank — we’ll give you a temporary one and you can switch later.

forgot.description: We will email you a link so you can set a new password.

forgotForm.intro: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgotForm.errorGeneric: The link could not be sent.
forgotForm.sentText: If that address has an account, we have just emailed it a link to reset the password. It expires in one hour.
forgotForm.sentSpam: Can't see it? Check your spam folder before requesting another one.

reset.metaDescription: Set a new password for your {brand} account.
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.

newPasswordForm.errorPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
newPasswordForm.errorGeneric: The password could not be changed.
newPasswordForm.expiredText: Links expire after one hour and can only be used once. Request a new one and try again.
newPasswordForm.doneText: You can now log in with your new password. For safety we have signed out any sessions open on other devices.

resetMail.subject: Reset your password — ViaHost
resetMail.intro: You asked to reset the password of your account on viahost.top.
resetMail.linkLabel: Open this link to set a new password:
resetMail.expiry: The link expires in one hour and can only be used once.
resetMail.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this message: your password will not change.

invoices.description: Your invoices and proformas, both from your orders and the ones we issue.
invoices.emptyText: When you order a service, its proforma will appear here and, once paid, its invoice.
invoices.pendingNotice: {count, plural, one {You have # invoice awaiting payment} other {You have # invoices awaiting payment}}.

invoiceDetail.metaDescription: Detail and payment of your {brand} invoice.
invoiceDetail.description: Invoice detail and available payment methods.
invoiceDetail.payIntro: Choose how you want to pay the {amount}.
invoiceDetail.methodCardNote: Immediate and secure. Your service is activated once confirmed.
invoiceDetail.methodTransferNote: Quote the invoice number as the reference. Usually takes 1-2 working days.
invoiceDetail.cardRedirectNote: We will take you to the secure gateway to enter your card details.
invoiceDetail.cardUnavailable: Card payment is not available right now. You can pay by bank transfer.
invoiceDetail.payError: The payment could not be started.
invoiceDetail.cancelledNote: This invoice is cancelled, there is nothing to pay.

servers.metaDescription: Manage the servers you have with {brand}.
servers.description: Power, console, snapshots and reinstallation for each of your servers.
servers.empty: You have no servers assigned yet.
servers.errorProvider: Your servers could not be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.

serverDetail.description: Everything you can do with this server without opening a ticket.
serverDetail.suspended: This server is suspended. Contact support.
serverDetail.taskStarted: Done. The server is applying the change.
serverDetail.powerIntro: Starting, stopping and restarting take a few seconds to show up.
serverDetail.passwordIntro: Generates a new root password and replaces the current one.
serverDetail.passwordOnce: Copy it now — it is shown once and not stored anywhere.
serverDetail.snapshotsIntro: A snapshot saves the current state of the server so you can go back to it later.
serverDetail.reinstallIntro: Installs the system from scratch. Everything on the server is erased and cannot be recovered.
serverDetail.reinstallConfirmHint: To continue, type the server name:
serverDetail.reinstallStarted: Reinstallation started. It takes a few minutes.
serverDetail.supportNote: Deleting a server, changing its plan and adding disks or IP addresses go through support.
serverDetail.errorBusy: The server is busy with another task. Wait for it to finish.
serverDetail.errorSuspended: This server is suspended. Contact support.
serverDetail.errorConfirmation: The name you typed does not match the server name.
serverDetail.errorConsole: The console could not be opened. Try again in a moment.
serverDetail.errorTooMany: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment.
serverDetail.errorGeneric: The action could not be completed.
serverDetail.credsIntro: We sent the password via a one-time link when the VPS was created. If you lost it or it expired, generate a new one.
serverDetail.credsSent: Done: we've emailed you a fresh link.
serverDetail.passwordProxmoxIntro: Generate a new password for the system user. It's sent to you by email through a one-time link.
serverDetail.passwordEmailed: New password generated. It's on its way by email with a one-time link.
serverDetail.reinstallConfirmIp: Type the server's IP to confirm:
serverDetail.errorUnsupported: This operation isn't available for this server.
serverDetail.consoleIntro: VNC access to the server screen, as if you were sitting in front of it. Handy when SSH is unresponsive or to boot into rescue mode.
serverDetail.consolePageIntro: Server VNC console. The session is single-use and expires within seconds; reconnect if it closes.
serverDetail.consoleIdle: Press Connect to open the console.
serverDetail.consoleNote: Everything you type goes straight to the server. Don't close the tab while working.

deployment.heading: Setting up your server
deployment.intro: We're creating your VPS. This usually takes a minute or two; you can leave this page open.
deployment.activeIntro: We've emailed your credentials with a one-time link.
deployment.failedNote: Don't worry: you won't be charged for a server that wasn't created. If the problem persists, contact support.

mfa.heading: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Add a second factor with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password, Bitwarden…). When signing in you'll be asked for a 6-digit code in addition to your password.
mfa.recoveryLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left: disable and re-enable to generate new ones.} one {# unused recovery code.} other {# unused recovery codes.}}
mfa.scanTitle: Scan the code with your app
mfa.scanHelp: Open your authenticator app, add an account by scanning the QR code and type the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
mfa.manualKey: If you can't scan, enter this key manually:
mfa.recoveryHelp: Each one works once to sign in if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.
mfa.disableHelp: To disable it, confirm your password and a current code from the app (or a recovery code).
mfa.adminForced: Your account is an administrator: two-step verification is required to access the /admin panel. Enable it here to continue.
mfa.errorExpired: The setup has expired (15 min). Start again.
mfa.errorGeneric: The operation could not be completed.
mfa.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.

profileForm.errorGeneric: The details could not be saved. Check the fields.
profileForm.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.
profileForm.emailHint: The email address is changed from the “Email address” section below.

changeEmailForm.errorSame: That is already the email of your account.
changeEmailForm.errorTaken: An account with this email already exists.
changeEmailForm.errorWrongPassword: The current password is not correct.
changeEmailForm.errorAdmin: Administrator accounts can't change their email here. Contact the technical team.
changeEmailForm.errorRate: Too many attempts. Please wait a while before trying again.
changeEmailForm.errorGeneric: The link could not be sent. Please try again.
changeEmailForm.errorConnection: Connection error. Check your network and try again.
changeEmailForm.sentText: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it from this browser to complete the change. It expires in one hour.
changeEmailForm.sentSpam: Can't see it? Check your spam folder. Your current email stays active until you confirm.

confirmEmail.metaDescription: Confirm the new email of your {brand} account.
confirmEmail.description: One last step for the new address to become your account email.
confirmEmail.text: You're about to change your account email to:
confirmEmail.sessionsNote: For security, confirming will sign out sessions open on other devices. This one stays signed in.
confirmEmail.errorToken: This link no longer works. Request a new one from your account.
confirmEmail.errorTaken: That email already belongs to another account.
confirmEmail.errorGeneric: The change could not be completed. Please try again.
confirmEmail.expiredText: Links expire after one hour, can only be used once, and must be opened while signed in to the account that requested the change. Request a new one from your account.
confirmEmail.doneText: From now on you'll sign in with {email}. We've notified your previous email for security.

emailChangeMail.subject: Confirm your new email — ViaHost
emailChangeMail.intro: You asked to change the email of your ViaHost account ({email}) to this address.
emailChangeMail.linkLabel: Open this link, while signed in to your account, to confirm the change:
emailChangeMail.expiry: The link expires in one hour and can only be used once.
emailChangeMail.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this message: the account email will not change.

emailChangedNotice.subject: Your account email has changed — ViaHost
emailChangedNotice.body: The email of your ViaHost account is now {email}. This address is no longer linked to the account and sessions open on other devices have been signed out.
emailChangedNotice.warning: If this wasn't you, reply to this message or write to soporte@viahost.top as soon as possible.
